Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — your trial is live

Hi Maria,

Thanks for signing up for the Redwood trial — we’ve reserved a short developer session slot to help you get started.

What’s next:
- Your trial environment is ready (credentials in your account)
- If you’d like a 15-minute walkthrough with an engineer, reply to this email or use the quick scheduler link below

Quick scheduler: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/book/quickstart

We also included a short checklist to make the most of your trial.

— Redwood Signup Team

Hi Maria — welcome to Redwood!

I’m Marcus (SDR technical lead) — congrats on getting your trial set up. If you have 15 minutes I can run a quick walkthrough focused on: model selection for latency-sensitive endpoints, running a sample inference pipeline, and a checklist of config recommendations.

If that works, pick any 15-minute slot here: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/marcus/15min
Or tell me a couple windows that work and I’ll book it.

I’m also looping in Ben, our AE, so we can keep product and procurement threads aligned. I attached a one-page trial checklist that maps to the walkthrough.

Quick agenda (optional):
- 5m: quick goals (your use case)
- 7m: demo / runbook (hand-on, example request)
- 3m: next steps & rollback/safety options

Thanks — look forward to connecting.

Marcus Lin
SDR — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
